17 open-source Bambu Lab projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Bambu Lab 3D printers. 15 of 17 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: bambuddy, ha-bambulab, Bambu RFID Tag Guide, X1Plus, OrcaSlicer-bambulab.
